rules.text: Command-line or environment input reaches an operating-system command routine
rules.impact: Whoever sets the program's command line or environment runs an arbitrary operating-system command with the program's authority
rules.remedy: Build the command only from fixed literals; never place input in the argument of CALL 'SYSTEM' or BPXWDYN. If it must vary, choose from an allow-list of known commands
steps: Find the CALL 'SYSTEM' (or C$SYSTEM, CBL_EXEC_RUN_UNIT) the finding names and the field or environment variable its command is built from.
Replace the command with a literal, or with an entry chosen from a fixed table of known commands by a key the program validates.
Reject the request when the key matches no entry; never STRING or MOVE input into the command text.

practices.text: A run-time check the policy requires is not turned on for a program
practices.why: No CBL or PROCESS card, compile step or declared site default turns the compiler option on, so an out-of-range subscript, a bad numeric value or a short argument is not caught where it happens and the program carries on with whatever storage it reached
practices.how: Turn the option on for the program: SSRANGE for subscripts and reference modification, NUMCHECK(ABD) for numeric data, PARMCHECK(ABD) for argument lengths
steps: Add the option to the estate's compile procedure, or to a CBL card at the top of the program
Record the estate's defaults as compilerOptions in cobolwork.site.json so the check can see them
Run the program's tests: a check that now abends shows where the program used storage it did not own

practices.text: A program compiles on defaults nobody declared
practices.why: It has no CBL or PROCESS card, no compile step the tree holds names it, and the site declares no compiler defaults, so how it is compiled is the installation default, which an installation can change from IBM's and the source cannot show
practices.how: Declare the estate's compiler defaults as compilerOptions in cobolwork.site.json, or put the options the program depends on on a CBL card
steps: Take the options from the compile procedure the estate uses, or from a compile listing's options section
Write them as compilerOptions in cobolwork.site.json

fixAt.test: before the operation at P2.cbl:10, on every route to it, test WS-LOCAL against a list of the values allowed (an EVALUATE with a WHEN for each literal and WHEN OTHER turning the rest away, or a condition name), and let only a value that passes reach it; a command built only from literals needs no test
